title: Thao Chi Boutique Realty - Tu van bat dong san chon loc
description: Thao Chi Boutique Realty tu van mua, ban va dau tu bat dong san theo nhu cau that: loc san pham, tham dinh gia, ho tro phap ly va dong hanh den khi giao dich hoan tat.
notice: Tu van bat dong san minh bach: moi thong tin ve gia, phap ly, tien do va chinh sach ban hang can duoc xac minh tren ho so thuc te truoc khi quyet dinh giao dich.

hero.eyebrow: Tu van bat dong san chon loc
hero.title: Tim dung can nha va co hoi dau tu phu hop
hero.lead: Thao Chi Boutique Realty dong hanh cung khach hang tu buoc xac dinh nhu cau, loc san pham, xem nha, thuong luong den hoan tat ho so. Moi de xuat deu duoc dat tren ngan sach, vi tri, phap ly va muc tieu su dung thuc te.
hero.micro: Phu hop voi nguoi mua de o, nha dau tu, chu nha can ban/cho thue va khach hang can danh gia bat dong san truoc giao dich.

terminal: > tiep nhan nhu cau: ngan sach, khu vuc, muc tieu
Phan khuc phu hop: can ho trung tam | nha pho | bds dong tien
> loc danh sach san pham co ho so ro rang
San sang: lich xem thuc te, bang so sanh, checklist phap ly

stages.label: 01 Nhu cau
stages.text: Lam ro ngan sach, vi tri, muc dich o/dau tu va thoi gian giao dich.

stages.label: 02 Loc san pham
stages.text: So sanh gia, phap ly, tien ich, thanh khoan va tiem nang tang gia.

stages.label: 03 Xem thuc te
stages.text: Sap lich xem nha, ghi nhan uu/nhuoc diem va chi phi phat sinh.

stages.label: 04 Giao dich
stages.text: Ho tro thuong luong, dat coc, cong chung va ban giao theo checklist.

trust.label: phan hoi danh sach phu hop
uu tien minh bach ho so

workflow.title: Quy trinh bat dong san duoc thiet ke de giam rui ro giao dich.
workflow.text: Thay vi dua khach xem that nhieu san pham khong lien quan, chung toi bat dau tu nhu cau that va dung checklist de loc bat dong san dang xem, dang dam phan va dang xuong tien.

cards.title: Chon nha theo loi song
cards.text: Danh gia vi tri, tien ich, huong nha, ket noi giao thong, moi truong song va chi phi so huu dai han.

cards.title: Phan tich dong tien va thanh khoan
cards.text: So sanh gia khu vuc, kha nang cho thue, bien do tang gia, chi phi von va kich ban thoat hang.

cards.title: Dinh vi san pham de ra hang tot hon
cards.text: Tu van gia chao, diem manh can truyen thong, ho so can chuan bi va cach sang loc khach mua/khach thue.

offer.title: Mot dau moi dong hanh tu luc xem nha den khi ban giao.
offer.text: Moi giao dich bat dong san deu co nhieu diem can kiem tra: gia, quy hoach, phap ly, chat luong tai san, dong tien, thue phi va dieu khoan dat coc. Thao Chi Boutique Realty giup ban gom tat ca vao mot quy trinh de ra quyet dinh ro rang hon.

checks.title: Khong day san pham dai tra
checks.text: Chi de xuat bat dong san phu hop voi nhu cau, ngan sach va muc tieu giao dich.

checks.title: Co bang so sanh truoc khi xem
checks.text: Moi danh sach deu co ly do de xem, diem can hoi va rui ro can xac minh.

checks.title: Dong hanh o cac moc quan trong
checks.text: Tu xem nha, thuong luong, dat coc, cong chung den ban giao tai san.

pricing.title: Bat dau bang mot buoi trao doi nhu cau
pricing.text: Buoi tu van dau tien giup xac dinh khu vuc, ngan sach, tieu chi loc san pham va muc tieu giao dich. Chi phi dich vu cu the se duoc thong nhat minh bach theo tung truong hop.

steps.title: Tiep nhan nhu cau va ngan sach.
steps.text: Ghi nhan khu vuc, loai tai san, muc tieu su dung, tien do va dieu kien tai chinh.

steps.title: Loc danh sach bat dong san phu hop.
steps.text: So sanh gia, vi tri, phap ly, tinh thanh khoan va cac diem can xac minh.

steps.title: Xem thuc te va thuong luong.
steps.text: Sap lich xem, danh gia uu/nhuoc diem, chuan bi cau hoi va chien luoc dam phan.

steps.title: Hoan tat ho so va ban giao.
steps.text: Theo doi dat coc, cong chung, thanh toan, thue phi va checklist ban giao.

faqIntro.title: Cau hoi thuong gap
faqIntro.text: Nhung diem khach hang thuong can lam ro truoc khi bat dau mua, ban hoac dau tu bat dong san.

faq.title: Toi chua ro nen mua khu vuc nao, co tu van duoc khong?
faq.text: Co. Chung toi bat dau tu nhu cau song, ngan sach, thoi gian di chuyen, muc tieu dau tu va muc do chap nhan rui ro de khoanh vung khu vuc phu hop.

faq.title: Thong tin phap ly duoc kiem tra nhu the nao?
faq.text: Moi ho so can duoc doi chieu voi giay to goc va co quan/chuyen gia lien quan khi can. Chung toi giup lap checklist cau hoi va diem can xac minh truoc khi dat coc.

faq.title: Neu toi can ban hoac cho thue nha thi sao?
faq.text: Chung toi co the ho tro dinh vi gia, chuan bi thong tin san pham, loc khach hang va xay quy trinh xem nha/giao dich gon hon.

faq.title: Co cam ket loi nhuan dau tu khong?
faq.text: Khong. Bat dong san luon co rui ro thi truong, phap ly va thanh khoan. Chung toi tap trung vao phan tich kich ban va minh bach du lieu de ban ra quyet dinh tot hon.

final.title: Bat dau tim bat dong san phu hop voi muc tieu cua ban
final.lead: Gui nhu cau ve khu vuc, ngan sach va muc dich mua/ban/cho thue. Chung toi se phan hoi voi huong loc san pham va cac buoc tiep theo.
